Simple from the start

Add a document in moments.

Capture the machine-readable zone, read the secure chip when available, and let IDVault organize the details.

01

Scan

Fast MRZ recognition captures supported passports, identity cards, visas, and driver’s licenses without manual typing.

02

Verify

On compatible iPhones, hold the device near a supported document to read the embedded NFC chip.

03

Protect

Sensitive document fields and images are encrypted before storage. Keys remain protected in Apple’s Keychain.

Privacy

Your documents are not anyone else’s data.

IDVault has no advertising SDKs, third-party analytics, or tracking tools. Document processing happens on your devices. If you enable iCloud sync, sensitive document data is encrypted before it is transmitted to and stored in your private iCloud account. Protected fields are shared only when you initiate or approve the disclosure.

  • Encrypted at restDocument data is protected using authenticated AES-GCM encryption.
  • Access stays intentionalProtected disclosures require authentication and can include a field-by-field review.
  • No permanent assistant accessApproved requests are one-time responses, not an open connection to your vault.
